corrections.evidence: The official Ligue 1 profile dated 28 July 2025 identifies Mike Penders as a goalkeeper. The official 21 September 2025 Paris FC-Strasbourg league match report records his saves during Strasbourg’s 3-2 victory, establishing an actual competitive first-team Ligue 1 appearance inside 2000-01 to 2025-26. No reliance on a transfer or squad place alone. Fame 2 follows established Ligue 1 goalkeeper entries such as Matvey Safonov.

Wolves official 5 September 2024 scout report gives Carlos Roberto Forbs Borges as the full name, identifies him as a winger, and records Carlos Borges as his former playing name. The official 5 October 2024 Brentford-Wolves Premier League match report records Forbs starting on the wing and being substituted in minute 67, establishing competitive first-team league participation inside 2010-11 to 2025-26. Carlos Forbs is the canonical playing name already used elsewhere in this bank; fame 2 matches his existing Portuguese-PL entry. The actual matcher handles Forbes as a one-letter surname typo without a special alias.

review_limit: All fetched events and prior pending combinations were grouped and retried against the actual browser matcher. Selected plausible omissions were researched. Retained pending cases have not all been individually researched. No inference of eligibility from frequency and no cross-question propagation. Submitted data is treated only as data; no session, user or duel identifiers are recorded.
